context: A teacher walks a uni student through a history-of-tech paper
purpose: Teach: 直径/潜水艦/機体/マスメディア/外科/刑法/栄光/団塊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は技術史のレポートを一緒に見ていきましょう。テーマは戦後の発明でしたね。
lines.en: Today let's review your tech history paper together. The theme was postwar inventions, right?
lines.style: Warm, composed teacher voice, gentle academic tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。冒頭で団塊世代が支えた高度成長と、マスメディアの発達を結びつけて書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I opened by linking the boomer generation's growth era with the rise of mass media.
lines.style: Earnest student, slightly nervous, careful articulation throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い視点です。ただ、第二章の航空機の節で、機体の直径の数値が出典なしになっていますよ。
lines.en: Good angle. But in chapter two on aircraft, the fuselage diameter figure has no citation.
lines.style: Gently corrective, pointing out concretely with polite teacher tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あ、本当だ……すみません。海上自衛隊の潜水艦の章と資料を取り違えたかもしれません。
lines.en: Oh, you're right, sorry. I might have mixed up the source with the chapter on submarines.
lines.style: Apologetic, flustered, self-correcting young man, personal cadence that sets them apart

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。それと、医療技術の項で外科手術ロボットを扱うなら、刑法上の責任の議論も少し触れた方がいいですね。
lines.en: Calm down. Also, if you cover surgical robots in the medical section, briefly touch on criminal-law liability.
lines.style: Reassuring, then guiding with concrete advice at a measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。刑法の改正論議まで広げると、技術と法の関係が立体的になりますね。
lines.en: I see. Extending it to the criminal-law reform debate would give tech and law more depth.
lines.style: Curious, intellectually engaged, brightening up, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。結論では、技術者の栄光だけでなく、社会が背負う代償も書けると説得力が増しますよ。
lines.en: Exactly. In the conclusion, address not just engineers' glory but society's costs, for stronger persuasion.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor, thoughtful, drawing the lesson together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。週末までに直して、もう一度見ていただけますか。
lines.en: Understood. I'll revise it by the weekend; could you look it over once more?
lines.style: Determined, respectful, ending on a polite request.
